purpose: Draws a GilbVeda type's picture at a given size, and draws nothing when the type has no picture or the picture fails to load.
namedChanges: `fetchTypePictureSrc` is `source.fetchTypePictureSrc`, where `source` is read from the new `TypePictureSourceContext` (`useContext`); with no source the hook returns null (the effect's first test became `!typeName || !source`); `source` is in the effect's dependency list after `typeName`.

bodies verbatim except: `TYPE_TERM_ORIGIN` is `opts.termOrigin`; `vaultOriginOf(id)` is `opts.originOf(id)`; `fetch(` is `(opts.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch)(`; the module-level `pictureCache` (line 89) is one `Map` per source, made inside the factory;

library.title: Type picture
library.note: Draws a type's picture or nothing; as a button that opens the definition take type-term-popover.
